name: v0.3.7 — Spending analysis combined section + working back nav
releaseNotes:
• 'Spending analysis' — engagement strip (GuacScore · GuacWizard · GuacMoney · Rewards) + 8-tile PaymentTile row consolidated under a single section with the period selector right above them, so it's clear what window the deltas are comparing.
• Back navigation actually works now — left-edge swipe pops the current screen, every AppBar shows the ← arrow, and drill-in taps build a real back stack (engagement tiles + feature cards switched from go() to push()).
• Smaller feature cards in the Smart shopping + Quick actions rows so the row feels lighter.
• Check for update pill on the Profile screen (manual trigger of the same flow the auto-check uses).
